Our story

From Cienfuegos to Kennewick.

“We are excited we can serve the community and bring something different. Add to this melting pot that America is.”Rafael Najarro, to NBC Right Now, 2025
2016

Rafael leaves Cienfuegos, Cuba, as a political refugee.

The road

El Salvador, Guatemala, Mexico, and finally the Tri-Cities.

6 years

He waits, and works, until his family can join him.

Together

The family is together again in the Tri-Cities. Today Rafael is a U.S. citizen.

Apr 30, 2025

Cuba Libre opens its window in west Kennewick.

Dec 2, 2025

Ribbon cutting at Columbia Gardens, on the waterfront.

Abuela’s recipes, Yeny’s hands.

Yeny is the chef. She cooks from the recipes of her mother and her grandmother, and the whole family works the truck beside her. Rafael calls it a labor of love, built on Cuban hospitality.

Rafael · Yeny · Jessica · Jennifer · Sophia · Raymond

El menú

Hot from the window.

Classic Cuban plates, made to order. Specials rotate, so check the board on the truck.
